column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each performance record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing TestSessions(SessionRegistry) to link performance metrics to a specific session.
A SMALLINT indicating the maximum acceleration (in G or m/s²) the device sensor can handle.
A SMALLINT for maximum tracking speed in inches per second (IPS) for pointing devices.
A NUMERIC(3,1) describing the lift-off distance in millimeters, often relevant for mouse sensors.
A BOOLEAN stating whether angle snapping (prediction or correction) is enabled.
An enum (BtnTens_enum) describing button tension (Light, Medium, or Heavy).
A NUMERIC(3,2) measuring click latency (in ms) from actuation to system registration.
A BIGINT noting the rated click durability (e.g., number of clicks before failure).
An enum (ScrollEncoder_enum) for the scroll wheel mechanism type (Mechanical, Optical, Magnetic).
A SMALLINT for how many discrete 'clicks' or steps a full scroll wheel rotation has.
A NUMERIC(4,1) reflecting the scroll wheel’s accuracy or consistency (on a relative scale).
